dash.title: Fair Sale Protocol
dash.intro: Configure how your team presents prices and options so customers are never rushed or pressured.
dash.legalNote: This tool supports good sales practice. It is not legal advice; check local consumer-protection rules.
dash.noAccessHint: You need compliance permissions to manage the Fair Sale Protocol.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

public.title: Our Fair Sale Promise
public.metaDescription: How we promise to treat every customer fairly: no rushing, clear prices and your right to change your mind.
public.lead: We want you to feel informed and in control at every step of your service visit.

items.never_rush: We will never rush you into a decision.
items.take_time: You can take the time you need to think it over.
items.summary: We give you a clear summary of the work and options.
items.price_check: We explain the price before any work begins.
items.trusted: You may consult someone you trust before you decide.
items.manager: You can ask to speak with a manager at any time.
items.payment: We explain payment terms clearly and in advance.
items.callback: You can ask us to call you back later.
items.no_guess: We will not guess or pressure; we only recommend what is needed.
items.emergency: In an emergency, we make the situation safe first and discuss the rest afterwards.

public.rights: You can decline any recommendation without penalty and withdraw your consent at any time.

notice.title: Notice
notice.body: This promise describes our standards of conduct and does not replace your statutory rights.

revoke.title: Revoke a recorded agreement
revoke.body: If you gave consent through a link and want to withdraw it, enter your revocation code below.
revoke.label: Revocation code
revoke.error: We could not revoke this code. Please check it and try again.

public.footnote: Questions? Contact the company that serviced you.
